def shrink_micro_batch(micro_batch: int) -> int:
    return max(1, micro_batch // 2)


def stm_epoch(
    model: MythosMini,
    optimizer: torch.optim.NAdam,
    pool: Tensor,
    indices: Tensor,
    config: StmConfig,
    dtype: torch.dtype,
) -> Tensor:
    losses = torch.zeros(indices.shape[0], device=pool.device)
    model.train()
    micro_batch = config.micro_batch
    start = 0
    while start < indices.shape[0]:
        position = indices[start : start + micro_batch]
        batch = pool[position]
        optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
        try:
            sample_losses = per_sample_loss(model, batch, config.loops, dtype)
        except torch.OutOfMemoryError:
            if batch.is_cuda:
                torch.cuda.empty_cache()
            if micro_batch == 1:
                raise
            old = micro_batch
            micro_batch = shrink_micro_batch(micro_batch)
            print(f"stm oom: micro batch {old} -> {micro_batch}")
            continue
        torch.autograd.backward(sample_losses.mean())
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), config.grad_clip)
        optimizer.step()
        losses[start : start + position.shape[0]] = sample_losses.detach()
        start += position.shape[0]
    return losses
